wien.heroText: Double your parking capacity in Vienna - even with limited space and strict building regulations.
wien.description: As Austria's capital and largest city, Vienna faces unique parking challenges. High land prices, listed heritage buildings and strict building codes call for innovative solutions to optimise parking space.
challenges: Extremely high land prices make every square metre valuable
Heritage protection complicates structural extensions
Strict parking-space regulations for new builds
Limited ceiling heights in period buildings
Shortage of parking in inner-city districts
solutions: Double the number of parking spaces without expanding the footprint
PARKER-S series designed specifically for low ceiling heights
Underground PARKER-O systems for heritage-protected areas
Meeting parking-space requirements in the smallest of spaces

faqs.question: Which parking system is suitable for Vienna's period buildings?
faqs.answer: For Vienna's period buildings, which typically have low ceiling heights, we recommend the PARKER-S series. These systems can be used from a ceiling height of just 295cm and use inclined platforms for minimal pit depth.

faqs.question: How do I comply with Vienna's parking-space regulations?
faqs.answer: With MODULO parking systems, you can provide the required number of parking spaces on half the area. For new builds, this significantly reduces the underground garage space needed.

faqs.question: Are there funding options for parking systems in Vienna?
faqs.answer: Funding may be available for parking systems that support e-mobility. We are happy to advise you on current funding opportunities.

wien.metaTitle: Parking Systems Vienna | Parking Platforms & Car Lifts for the Capital
wien.metaDescription: MODULO parking systems for Vienna: parking platforms, car lifts and double parkers for underground garages, apartment buildings and commercial use. Consulting & installation in Vienna and the surrounding area.

niederoesterreich.heroText: Space-saving parking solutions for Lower Austria - from St. Pölten to the outskirts of Vienna.
niederoesterreich.description: As Austria's largest province, Lower Austria combines urban centres such as St. Pölten with rural regions. Demand for space-saving parking solutions for single-family homes and residential developments is rising particularly in the areas surrounding Vienna.
challenges: Growing residential areas around Vienna
Rising number of vehicles per household
Limited plot sizes in new construction projects
Retrofitting parking needs in existing buildings
Lack of space in historic town centres
solutions: STACKER-P10 as a compact solution for small plots
PARKER-O underground systems for front gardens

faqs.question: Which system for my single-family home in Lower Austria?
faqs.answer: For single-family homes, we recommend the PARKER-C100 Basic as a cost-effective solution, or the PARKER-O100 for underground installation that leaves your garden untouched.

faqs.question: Can parking systems be retrofitted?
faqs.answer: Yes, many of our systems are suitable for retrofitting. The STACKER-P10 needs only 2.5m of width and can often be installed without major structural changes.

niederoesterreich.metaTitle: Parking Systems Lower Austria | Parking Platforms for Lower Austria
niederoesterreich.metaDescription: MODULO parking systems for Lower Austria: car lifts and double parkers for single-family homes, residential developments and commercial use in St. Pölten, Baden, Mödling and throughout Lower Austria.

oberoesterreich.heroText: Efficient parking solutions for Upper Austria's industry and private households.
oberoesterreich.description: As an industrial province with hubs such as Linz, Wels and Steyr, Upper Austria has a strong demand for efficient parking solutions for commercial and industrial use. Private households also benefit from space-saving systems.
challenges: High parking demand in industrial zones
Employee parking at growing companies
Limited space in urban centres
Apartment buildings with too few parking spaces
Historic town centres with a lack of space
solutions: PALLET-Systems for automated large-scale car parks

faqs.question: Which system for commercial businesses in Upper Austria?
faqs.answer: For commercial businesses, depending on requirements, we recommend the LS-Systems with up to 3 levels or the fully automated PALLET-System for maximum efficiency with minimal staff input.

faqs.question: Do you offer service throughout Upper Austria?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer consulting, installation and service throughout Upper Austria - from Linz to the Mühlviertel, from the Innviertel to the Salzkammergut.

oberoesterreich.metaTitle: Parking Systems Upper Austria | Parking Platforms Linz & Upper Austria
oberoesterreich.metaDescription: MODULO parking systems for Upper Austria: industrial and private parking solutions in Linz, Wels, Steyr and throughout Upper Austria. Car lifts, double parkers and automated systems.

salzburg.heroText: Discreet parking solutions for Salzburg - from the historic old town to modern residential projects.
salzburg.description: The festival city of Salzburg combines historic heritage with modern living. Limited space in the old town and strict building regulations call for well-thought-out parking solutions that blend in harmoniously.
challenges: UNESCO World Heritage old town with strict requirements
High tourism with seasonal parking pressure
Limited expansion options for hotels
Steep hillside locations complicate underground garage construction
Premium properties with high demands
solutions: Multi-level LS-Systems for new residential projects

faqs.question: What solutions are available for hotels in Salzburg?
faqs.answer: For hotels, we recommend the PALLET-System with fully automated operation. Guests drop off their vehicle and the system takes over automatically - perfect for concierge service.

faqs.question: Are parking systems possible in Salzburg's old town?
faqs.answer: Yes, with the underground PARKER-O100 you can create parking spaces even in the sensitive old town area. The surface remains untouched and blends in harmoniously.

salzburg.metaTitle: Parking Systems Salzburg | Parking Platforms for City & Country
salzburg.metaDescription: MODULO parking systems for Salzburg: discreet parking platforms for the festival city, car lifts for residential projects and automated systems for hotels.

tirol.heroText: Robust parking solutions for Tyrol's demanding alpine conditions.
tirol.description: In the Tyrolean Alps, building land is especially valuable. Steep slopes, snow loads and the demands of tourism place particular requirements on parking systems. MODULO offers robust solutions for alpine conditions.
challenges: Limited building land in valley locations
Steep hillside locations complicate garage construction
High snow loads and alpine weather
Seasonal parking pressure from tourism
Premium chalets with limited plot size
solutions: Fully galvanised construction for snow and moisture
PARKER-S for hillside locations with height restrictions
STACKER-V10 as the lightest variant for rooftop garages
Robust systems for commercial ski-park facilities

faqs.question: Are MODULO systems suitable for alpine winters?
faqs.answer: Yes, all MODULO systems are fully galvanised and therefore optimally protected against corrosion from snow, road salt and moisture. The robust steel construction withstands alpine conditions.

faqs.question: Which system for chalets in Tyrol?
faqs.answer: For chalets, depending on the situation, we recommend the PARKER-O100 (underground) for discreet integration or the STACKER-V10 for existing garages with limited height.

tirol.metaTitle: Parking Systems Tyrol | Parking Platforms Innsbruck & the Alpine Region
tirol.metaDescription: MODULO parking systems for Tyrol: robust parking platforms for alpine conditions in Innsbruck, Kitzbühel, Kufstein and the Tyrolean ski resorts.

steiermark.heroText: Flexible parking solutions for Styria - from Graz to Upper Styria.
steiermark.description: Styria combines the provincial capital of Graz with rural regions and industrial sites. The diversity of requirements - from urban underground garages to commercial parking solutions - calls for flexible systems.
challenges: Urban densification pressure in Graz
Industrial sites with employee parking needs
Growing residential areas on the city outskirts
Historic Graz old town
Diverse requirements depending on the region
solutions: PARKER-C for residential developments on the city outskirts
Discreet solutions for the old town

faqs.question: Which systems for new construction projects in Graz?
faqs.answer: For new construction projects in Graz, we recommend early involvement in the planning. With LS-Systems, you can achieve maximum parking spaces on a minimal footprint.

faqs.question: Do you offer service for industrial businesses?
faqs.answer: Yes, we look after numerous industrial customers in Styria. From needs analysis through installation to 24/7 service - everything from a single source.

steiermark.metaTitle: Parking Systems Styria | Parking Platforms Graz & Surroundings
steiermark.metaDescription: MODULO parking systems for Styria: parking platforms for Graz, Leoben and Styrian industry. Car lifts, double parkers and commercial solutions.

kaernten.heroText: Parking solutions for Carinthia's lakes and cities - discreet and space-saving.
kaernten.description: Carinthia's lakes and mountains make the province a tourist hotspot. Hotels, holiday apartments and residential developments in these sought-after locations benefit from space-saving parking solutions.
challenges: Premium lakeside locations with limited building land
Seasonal tourism with parking peaks
Hotels with too few guest parking spaces
Growing residential construction in Klagenfurt
Lack of space in tourist town centres

faqs.question: What solutions for hotels at Lake Wörthersee?
faqs.answer: For lakeside hotels we offer underground PARKER-O systems that do not impair the valuable lake view, as well as automated PALLET-Systems for convenient valet parking.

faqs.question: Can parking systems be expanded seasonally?
faqs.answer: Yes, with modular systems you can adjust capacity flexibly. Additional parking-space levels can be activated for the high season.

kaernten.metaDescription: MODULO parking systems for Carinthia: parking platforms for hotels at Lake Wörthersee, residential developments in Klagenfurt and tourist facilities throughout Carinthia.

burgenland.heroText: Modern parking solutions for the growing Burgenland - from Eisenstadt to Lake Neusiedl.
burgenland.description: Burgenland combines winegrowing, tourism and growing residential areas close to Vienna. Demand for modern parking solutions is rising particularly in northern Burgenland due to its proximity to the federal capital.
challenges: Strong population growth in northern Burgenland
Commuter traffic to Vienna
Tourism at Lake Neusiedl
Wineries with guest parking needs
New residential developments requiring parking spaces
solutions: PARKER-C for single-family homes and double garages

faqs.question: Which system for wineries in Burgenland?
faqs.answer: For wineries with guest traffic, we recommend the PARKER-C100 or a compact STACKER system. This lets you double the parking spaces for wine tastings without using additional space.

faqs.question: Do you also offer service in southern Burgenland?
faqs.answer: Yes, we cover the entire Burgenland from Neusiedl to Jennersdorf. Travel for consulting and service is possible throughout the province.

burgenland.metaTitle: Parking Systems Burgenland | Parking Platforms Eisenstadt & Surroundings
burgenland.metaDescription: MODULO parking systems for Burgenland: parking platforms for wineries, residential developments in Eisenstadt and the growing housing market near Vienna.

vorarlberg.heroText: Space-saving parking solutions for Vorarlberg's limited valley areas.
vorarlberg.description: As Austria's westernmost province, Vorarlberg combines alpine topography with economic strength. Limited valley areas, high land prices and snow loads call for intelligent parking solutions.
challenges: Extremely limited valley areas
High land prices in the Rhine Valley
Alpine weather with high snow loads
Economically strong region with parking pressure
Location near the border with commuter traffic
solutions: Fully galvanised systems for alpine conditions
PARKER-S for hillside locations and narrow valleys

faqs.question: Are the systems suitable for Vorarlberg winters?
faqs.answer: Yes, all MODULO systems are fully galvanised and designed for alpine snow loads. The hydraulic systems also operate reliably at low temperatures.

faqs.question: What solutions for commercial businesses in the Rhine Valley?
faqs.answer: For the economically strong businesses in the Rhine Valley, we offer scalable LS-Systems and automated PALLET solutions for efficient employee and visitor parking.

vorarlberg.metaDescription: MODULO parking systems for Vorarlberg: robust parking platforms for the Rhine Valley, Bregenz, Dornbirn and the Vorarlberg alpine region.
